prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit / production game UI asset extraction. The attached image is the exact approved style. Create a clean reusable 2D UI skin ATLAS on genuinely transparent background, 1536x1024. Preserve its black finely grained leather, softly worn thin copper edge and shallow black shadow EXACTLY; no text, no symbols, no dice, no decorative engraving. Straight-on orthographic screen UI, zero perspective.
Arrange SEPARATE pieces with generous transparent gutters, no touching, all axis aligned:
1) Across top-left x32 y32, a wide horizontal black leather rectangular panel, approximately 1000x220. Copper line is very thin (about 3 pixels); small softened corners. Completely blank inside, uniform leather.
2) Across middle-left x32 y310, a wide horizontal black leather HEADER panel approximately 1000x180 with the small inward STEP at bottom-right, like the reference header (last 36px of right side ends 20px before bottom). Thin copper border follows exact silhouette. Blank inside.
3) Across lower-left x32 y550, a wide horizontal black leather FOOTER panel approximately 1000x140 with same tiny lower-right inward step, thin copper border following silhouette. Blank inside.
4) At x1120 y32, a blank black leather rectangular weapon TAB approximately 250x160 with the same thin copper edge.
5) At x1130 y320, ONE small vertical leather connector strap approximately 70x95: black woven leather rolled over the top and bottom, copper metal caps only at left and right. This is the connector in the input. No background card.
6) At x1120 y550, ONE blank square pale ivory roll BUTTON approximately 160x150 with gently rounded/beveled edge and shallow contact shadow, same material as reference. Entire ivory face plain, no die or text.
Every piece must have complete outer edge and isolated soft short shadow on transparent canvas. No other artifacts. Do not draw a complete window. This is a texture atlas that Godot will nine-slice; keep middle areas visually even and stretchable. All outside pixels truly transparent. No labels or coordinate guides.

Remove the entire brown/black background from this UI sprite atlas. Keep all SIX separate UI pieces, every copper frame, black leather face, strap and ivory button completely unchanged in their current exact positions, shapes and scale. Remove the ambient brown glow and all broad background shading. Outside each object's outermost black outline must be transparent alpha, not black, not white, not a checker pattern. Preserve the intentional concave notch cutouts as transparent. Keep leather interiors black, NOT transparent. This is a game texture atlas with six fully isolated sprites, ready to composite over any scene. 1536x1024 exact same layout. No new content.
notes: Atlas regions and nine-patch margins are stock Godot Resources. Approved illustrated D20 retained in ai-generated-approved-roll-source.png; only that region is rendered. No rules text is baked into the panel skins.
